title: Logical Replication for HA
description: Use logical replication for selective HA and migrations.

data.text: Logical replication replicates changes at the row level. Use it for selective replication and online migrations.

data.title: Publication
data.code: CREATE PUBLICATION ha_pub FOR TABLE users, orders WITH (publish = 'insert, update, delete');

data.title: Subscription
data.code:
CREATE SUBSCRIPTION ha_sub
  CONNECTION 'host=primary dbname=appdb user=replicator password=secret'
  PUBLICATION ha_pub
  WITH (copy_data = false);

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use logical replication for version upgrades and multi-master.
